notes.frozen_pop: Population bucket assignments use 2020 ACS B01003_001E (5-year vintage). Frozen for the lifetime of the calibration vintage; re-run this script to refresh.
notes.suspended_2020_1y: 1-year ACS was suspended for 2020 due to COVID data quality. Folds with target_year=2020 are dropped silently downstream.

selection_method: xlarge: top-N by 2020 pop; medium/small: deterministic random sample seeded with 42; Hawaii counties always included
